subject: Pricing follow-up: startup program, committed-use & multi-year incentives
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.coale@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Meyers <jordan@greenleafapp.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Mar 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Pricing follow-up: token volumes & discounts

Thanks again for the demo today — great conversation. Quick recap and next steps on the pricing side so we can get a tight quote over to you: 

Recap from discovery:
- Expected launch: pilot in June, GA in Q4.
- Volume profile you mentioned: ~20M tokens/month for months 1–2 ramping to ~80–100M tokens/month by month 6.
- Key goal: unit economics target in the ballpark of $30–$50 per 1M tokens (target $/1M tokens).
- Primary ask: options for (1) startup program credits / one-time incentives, (2) committed-use discounts (12/24 month), and (3) multi-year pricing incentives.

I attached our standard pricing overview (redwood-pricing-2026-q1.pdf). Two quick questions to help me size proposals: 
1) Which committed-use bucket would you be comfortable evaluating (options below)? A: <$50k/yr, B: $50–200k/yr, C: $200–500k/yr, D: >$500k/yr.
2) Is your procurement OK with a 12-mo term or do you prefer 24-mo / prepaid?

Next step: I’ll draft 2 quote options — a startup credit + short-term discount, and a 12/24-mo committed pricing tier — and get them to you by EOD tomorrow. If you can confirm the committed bucket (Q1) and procurement preference (Q2) that’ll speed things up.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachment: redwood-pricing-2026-q1.pdf
From: Jordan Meyers <jordan@greenleafapp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.coale@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Mar 2026 12:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing follow-up: token volumes & discounts

Thanks Marissa — great summary. A few notes on our side: 
- Confirmed: pilot June (20M tokens/month), ramp to ~100M/month over 6 months.
- Budget: for pilot stage we have ~$25k/month allocated; plan is to move to a committed budget once we validate quality. Roughly that maps to $300k–$400k annual run-rate once GA.
- Procurement: prefers 12-mo committed use to start. Open to 24-mo if the economics are compelling.

Specific asks: 
1) What would a typical 12-month committed-use discount look like for our expected ramp (20M -> 100M/month)? Please show example unit price per 1M tokens and total committed spend scenarios.
2) What does your startup program include? Any upfront credits or accelerated discounts for early-stage customers?

I attached a simple forecast (product-monthly-forecast.xlsx) to help with example math. Feel free to prototype a few commitment tiers against that.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — Jordan
Jordan Meyers

jordan@greenleafapp.com | (617) 555-0134

Attachment: product-monthly-forecast.xlsx
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.coale@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Meyers <jordan@greenleafapp.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Mar 2026 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing follow-up: token volumes & discounts

Thanks Jordan — great context. Below are two concrete proposal templates and an example worked against your attached forecast. I kept the math at $/1M tokens so you can compare to your target $30–$50/1M.

1) Startup Program (fast path, limited-time)
- Eligibility: Series A or earlier, < $5M ARR (self-attest + basic docs).
- Offer: $10k platform credit + 40% off list hosted price for first 6 months (applies to usage up to $100k).
- No required committed spend; credit applies at invoice level.
- Example: If pilot uses $25k in month 1, the $10k credit reduces net month 1 to $15k.

2) Committed-Use Pricing (preferred for predictable discounts)
Pricing assumptions: list hosted price for the model(s) discussed = $50 per 1M tokens (list for this example). Discounts applied to list.
- 12-mo commit: 30% off list → effective $35/1M tokens.
- 24-mo commit: 40% off list → effective $30/1M tokens.
- Prepay / upfront payment: additional 5% off commit net price.

Worked example (using your ramp):
- Months 1–2: 20M/mo → 20 * $35 = $700/month (12-mo commit price is illustrative; real quotes will aggregate across total commit).
- Month 6: 100M -> 100 * $35 = $3,500/month.
- Over 12 months, using your ramp profile, the committed spend estimate is ~$120k (example).

Notes & caveats:
- We can shape the committed profile (e.g., ramp schedule) in the contract to allow ramp credits; this is standard for fast-growing customers.
- Multi-year/24-mo commitments require a small legal term amendment but give better unit economics.
- Startup program + committed use: we can combine the $10k startup credit with a small first-year committed discount for early adopters — I’ll flag that with my manager for approval.

Attachments: startup-program-terms.pdf (high-level), redwood-pricing-2026-q1.pdf

Next steps: I’ll draft 2 detailed quotes for you — (A) Startup path (no commit + credits + 6-month promo) and (B) 12-mo committed use (with ramp schedule). Aim to have these to you by EOD tomorrow. Can you confirm: 12-mo preference (yes/no) and which committed bucket you think you’ll target (<$50k, $50–200k, $200–500k, >$500k)?

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
